notes.title: PLACEBO LOVE v1.2 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey there, Lonely Lovers!

Are you ready for more mystery? More romance? More of the unending search for the meaning of love in the loneliness of life? 

PLACEBO LOVE v1.2 is here for you!

Now with 1.2 times the flavor!

HIGHLIGHTS

 Character portraits updated!
 Two new endings!
 Placebo Love OST available on Steam!
 Changed map visuals!
 Generally, lots more stuff inside!


OTHER CHANGES

 New Title screen
 More beverage imagery
 Tweaked Victor story progression
 Added a whole new side character who appears in certain stories
 Gave portraits to some characters who had none
 Fixed a game-breaking bug in the Victor "Romance" choice
 Changed name of Streetside Bakery to Eroma Bakery
 Opened secondary route for unlocking Brenda
 Added scene when spending Desert Event (Skyring Launch) alone
 Added ability to spend Influence on new Decor
 Enabled MOTHEMO during Alone Time
 Enabled LERV game during Alone Time (NG+)
 Nerfed VPET to gain watch energy only after eating pancakes.
 Added some Kan Gao and Fleur songs to the jukebox
 Updated songs by Abrankar Blanco for the jukebox
 Enabled ability to skip the hallway in certain endings
 Enabled ability to skip the ending credits
 Fixed NEGLECT bug where if you have too low of influence you could get trapped
 Added a small indicator of secret stat when making relevant Honesty decisions
 Added the Honesty "thought" to the convo log
 Enabled convo log when choosing Honesty answers
 Adjusted visuals of convo log
 Updated Contacts App aesthetic a little
 Fixed some music volume issue
 Fixed some VSFX audio issues
 Tweaked the Options Menu
 Changed visual pacing of Diana meetcute
 Added Diana meetcute daydream
 Added Nadia meetcute daydream
 Altered some minor lighting in a few scenes
 Added Ending name to Ending wheel at the end of the game
 Small text placement adjustments
 Made aesthetic additions by way of phone use
 Adjusted email text height
 Aesthetic changes to Browse
 Fixed letter height in Browse
 Adjusted the dance sequence controls
 Adjusted Archive text line height to be more readable
 Fixed issue in Archive app with blue texts
 Fixed InspiRationalist newsletter
 Fixed some cursor errors
 Fixed many other bugs
 Added numerous QoL changes


OLD SAVE FILES

Your old save files will probably blow up the whole world if you try to play them. I mean, go ahead if you like. Give it a shot. 

However, your NG+ data should carry over into v1.2!

PLAYING v1.0

If you ever want to play v1.0, go into Steam, select Placebo Love, right click, go to 

Properties -> 
Betas -> 
version1.0 

and wait for it to update. 

TELL ME STUFF

Tell me what you think! Let me know! Bugs, thoughts, hearts, love... anything! Ask me things!

I LOVE YOU, AND NOT THE PLACEBO KIND

Thanks, everyone, for all of your support! Special thanks to everyone who helped give feedback for the update. Super special thanks to Kayden and Vic for being incredible artists!

Like, comment, subscribe, and hit that bell to get notifications!

notes.title: Placebo Love V1.2 Upcoming! + Art Update
notes.notes:
Hey, Lonely Lovers!

A large patch is going to be released early next year (2024). I'm hoping for January, but we'll see!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/91cba3_492443f41ed44b17900fa4374438c8aa~mv2.png

What Can I Expect?

There will be a lot of big and small changes in Placebo Love with the next update, most of which I'll outline when the time comes. For now, the main things to know are:

Profile Images

Character art assets have been changed to a pixelated style, only possible with the wonderful superpowers of Vic Mietus. Some of the designs of the characters have changed to better fit this style, like how Tristan decided to stop shaving his head between updates!

https://static.wixstatic.com/media/91cba3_360957ee2d1743b2a639270182db8b3d~mv2.png

New Endings

Two new endings have been added. Each of these are a little peculiar in that they require a person to NOT have full Bonds in order to unlock them. Strange! Weird! But okay!

For those who have seen the endings wheel, you probably noticed some blank spots. Those had always been meant to be other endings, which I never got to complete. Now, they exist!

There are two cheevos that are linked to these endings. Previously, both cheevos were earned automatically when viewing the ending [Alternative Solutions]. Now they will be split between the two new endings. That said, if you have already unlocked those cheevos, nothing will change for you.

Victor Route

Victor's route is mostly the same, but compared to everyone else, his route has undergone the most changes. Some extra characters show up throughout, and, as he likes to say, he always leaves on the "taste of a woman." Hm.

These changes were made for two reasons. One, it helps set up implications for one of the new endings. And two, Victor's route has always been a tough sell among players, so maybe some of the new stuff will act as bait.

Rawn

He's still Rawn.

Other Stuff

There's also other stuff! I'll be putting up the OST, making MOTHEMO accessible after Ash events, and dealing with bugs, typos, and QoL features.

What About My Save Files?

Okay, save files might not work. They could, but I expect there to be bugs here and there if you use them. To be safe, go ahead and play V1.2 from the beginning.

What If I Want to Play The Old Version?

No problem. I'll leave that accessible in a public Beta branch. This might be useful if you want to finish off a save file before updating. Or if you're just not a fan of lost media.

How Do I Stave Off the Loneliness?

... I wish I knew.

How Can I Help?

Suggestions

Glad you asked! If you've played before, and have some feedback on things you'd like to see in V1.2, let me know! I'm open to suggestions and corrections.

Spread the Word

Also, if you like the game, and want to support me more somehow... spread the word! Once V1.2 is out, the immediate art impressions will be a little different, and it might be more attractive to a general audience. Help me show people!

Reviews

Reviews are good, too. If you liked the game, please leave a review! If you didn't like the game, please don't!

notes.title: Hotfix 21.10.06
notes.notes:
Got around to implementing a couple little changes and fixes that hopefully make the experience run as smooth as thirst-quenching carbonated beverages!

The biggest change is that you can now hang out with people after being CONNECTED with them. It's a soft replica sequence of Alone Time but with the person of your choice. Plus there's a gentle mini-game. It's not much, but it's nice. I may add more to that as time allows. ;)

- Fixed bug that locked game if you didn't go to the silo with Nadia/Diana
- Fixed double music in CC Bond 2
- Adjusted text alignment of conversation log
- Xu Silo image in certain endings
- Changed Neglect cost values (10 min., 1 after upgrade)
- Fixed issue with Rawn's survey
- Post-Connected hangouts
- Fora Bolsonaro
- Little RPS minigame during post-Connect hangouts
- The Girls become Invested if chosen for mid-week events
- Trist becomes Invested at Museum

Peace, y'all!
